newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Trading of Hwan Yung shrs halted Jan 3.
newsitem.headline: Trading of Hwan Yung shrs halted Jan 3.

text.p: The Korea Stock Exchange said on Saturday trading of Hwan Yung Steel Industry Co's shares would be suspended for one day on January 3.
An exchange statement said the suspension was in line with Hwan Yung's application for court receivership.
Hwan Yung said in a statement it has filed the application with a court in Pusan due to worsening financial position.
Trading of Hwan Yung shares will be resumed on January 4.
January 3 is the first trading day of 1997 for the market which is closed from Saturday until January 2 for year-end clearance of transactions and the New Year holidays.
